i.norm: A custom {@link TemporalQuery} (one that is neither the chronology nor the precision query) is delegated by {@link Half#query} to the default {@code TemporalAccessor} behaviour, which simply invokes the query's {@code queryFrom} method. This verifies that whatever the query returns (here, {@code null}) is passed straight back to the caller.
